image_asset.title: Rama Natha's 6-Year Transformation & Banana Plantation Economics
image_asset.caption: Flowchart and Financial Chart tracing Rama Natha's shift from potion obsession to profitable banana farming.

hotspots.label: Obsession & Neglect
hotspots.description: Rama Natha ignores his inherited agricultural fields, losing money to swindlers.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: Rama Natha inherited vast tracts of land but wasted his fortune chasing a mythical potion.

hotspots.label: Sage's Condition
hotspots.description: Sage Mahipati requires 5 litres of winter morning dew from banana leaves.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: Sage Mahipati framed 6 years of hard physical labor as a magic ritual to teach a lifelong lesson.

hotspots.label: 6 Years of Labor
hotspots.description: Rama Natha clears land and plants banana trees while Madhumati sells harvested fruit.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: Madhumati harvested bananas from thousands of trees, accumulating a box of real gold coins.

hotspots.label: Banana Economics Chart
hotspots.description: Financial comparison between swindler losses and banana sale profits.
hotspots.interactive_popup_text: Banana sales yielded 15,000 rupees in gold coins, proving hard work creates true wealth.
